purpose: Horizontal divider with role="separator" that visually segments groups of rows inside a dropdown-menu.
useWhen: Visually splitting unrelated groups of dropdown-item rows without adding a heading.
Marking a boundary between primary actions and destructive or secondary actions in a menu.

avoidWhen.reason: Labeling a section of items — use dropdown-label so the group has an accessible heading.
Rendering an interactive row — use dropdown-item.
